nodes.label: backend_info command (base_url + token)
nodes.rationale: A random free port plus a per-launch bearer token harden a loopback-only service that any local process can otherwise reach; Rust generates both and hands them to the frontend.

nodes.label: Go as mobile library (c-shared / c-archive FFI)
nodes.norm_label: go as mobile library (c-shared / c-archive ffi)
nodes.rationale: Sidecars are unsupported on mobile (tauri issue #9774) and iOS cannot spawn bundled executables, so the same Go code must be built as a library loaded into the app process.

nodes.label: Parent-PID watcher (watchParent)
nodes.rationale: kill() only sends SIGTERM, so a force-killed app could leave an orphaned sidecar; the Go process exits itself when its parent PID changes.

nodes.label: Tauri sidecar (spawned Go binary)
nodes.rationale: Tauri cannot run Go in-process, so the Fiber server is compiled to a binary, bundled as externalBin and spawned from lib.rs, with the WebView talking to it over 127.0.0.1.

nodes.label: __TAURI_INTERNALS__ + DEV mock guard
nodes.rationale: The mock installs only in a plain browser during dev so cargo tauri dev and production builds always run real IPC; import.meta.env.DEV keeps it out of release bundles.

nodes.label: Mock scenarios (?mock=empty|error|slow)
nodes.rationale: URL-driven scenarios let empty states, error toasts and loading UI be designed and tested without touching code.

nodes.label: detectUiMode() UI selection
nodes.rationale: UI mode is decided once at startup (not on resize) so page state is never destroyed mid-session; screen width is deliberately unused so a narrow desktop window stays on the desktop UI.

nodes.label: Framework7 is UI only — SvelteKit owns routing
nodes.norm_label: framework7 is ui only — sveltekit owns routing
nodes.rationale: A single history manager (SvelteKit) keeps the browser/system back gesture popping in-app history instead of exiting the app; the old second history manager caused exactly that bug, so F7's router and clicks interception (externalLinks: 'a') are disabled.

nodes.label: Per-route UI branching (desktop static / mobile dynamic import)
nodes.norm_label: per-route ui branching (desktop static / mobile dynamic import)
nodes.rationale: Each route statically imports the desktop skeleton but dynamically imports the mobile page so framework7-svelte never enters the desktop bundle.

nodes.label: Two UIs, one core
nodes.rationale: domain/, data/ and network/ never import a UI library, so desktop shadcn and mobile Framework7 pages share one feature core.

nodes.label: View Transitions API page transitions
nodes.rationale: With the F7 router removed there is no push/pop animation, so it is reimplemented with document.startViewTransition reusing Framework7's own keyframes, skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Layered presentation architecture
nodes.rationale: Layers route pages through feature components and shared *.base wrappers so the underlying UI kit (shadcn) can be swapped or replaced without touching feature code.

nodes.label: Framework7 mobile UI layer
nodes.rationale: Phones/tablets get Framework7 and desktops get shadcn; mobile pages are lazily imported so framework7-svelte never enters the desktop bundle.

nodes.label: TodosApi backend contract (src/network/types.ts)
nodes.rationale: A typed contract (GET/POST /todos, GET/PATCH/DELETE /todos/:id) lets VITE_USE_MOCK swap a seeded mock for any real backend without changing feature code.
